about: The Communion antiphon of the feast of the Most Holy Body of Christ. It joins reception of the Bread and Chalice to proclamation of the Lord’s death and warns against unworthy reception.

seg.tr: As often as you eat this Bread and drink the Chalice, you will proclaim the death of the Lord until He comes. Therefore whoever eats the Bread or drinks the Chalice of the Lord unworthily will be guilty of the Body and Blood of the Lord. Alleluia.
